# 2. Confirm recovery/clean-source on GitHub via API
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/owner_token_fresh.txt 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then
    curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if d.get('success') and d.get('accessToken'):
    with open('/tmp/owner_token_fresh.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(d['accessToken'])
    print(f'Token refreshed: {len(d[\"accessToken\"])} chars')
else:
    print(f'ERROR: {json.dumps(d)[:300]}')
"
    TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/owner_token_fresh.txt)
fi

echo "=== GITHUB BRANCH STATUS ==="
for branch in "main" "main-broken-archive" "recovery/clean-source"; do
    RESULT=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
      -d "{\"action\":\"github_get_repo_head\",\"input\":{\"branch\":\"$branch\"}}" 2>/dev/null)
    SHA=$(echo "$RESULT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); r=d.get('result',d); print(r.get('headSha','NOT_FOUND'))" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "  $branch: $SHA"
done

echo ""
echo "=== LOCAL HEAD vs REMOTE MAIN ==="
LOCAL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
REMOTE_SHA=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"action":"github_get_repo_head","input":{"branch":"main"}}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); r=d.get('result',d); print(r.get('headSha','?'))" 2>/dev/null)
echo "  Local HEAD:  $LOCAL_SHA"
echo "  Remote main: $REMOTE_SHA"
if [ "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$REMOTE_SHA" ]; then
    echo "  MATCH: ✅"
else
    echo "  MISMATCH: ⚠️ (local workspace may be ahead/behind)"
fi

curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"action":"github_create_branch","confirm":true,"confirmText":"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE","input":{"name":"pre-cutover-verified","fromBranch":"main"}}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
r = d.get('result', d)
print(f'  ok: {d.get(\"ok\")}')
print(f'  result: {json.dumps(r)[:400]}')
" 2>/dev/null
